propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes, not vendor-shaped payloads; vendor shapes cross core boundaries solely as opaque data produced/consumed by port calls (OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote, InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local).

All package-root reconciler modules must have zero vendor reach-through: no adapters.jira or acli_subprocess imports, no lazy-key literals for adapters/jira/, no by-path loads of vendor siblings (except inbound_fields.py which is pending relocation).
The 8 Jira vendor modules (acli, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) must be physically relocated to adapters/jira/ with import loaders repointed and no re-export shims.
Outbound and link differs must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper before comparison and build vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper at emission boundaries.

Backend selection must route through config.reconciler.backend registry with select_backend() providing the port interface; all 4 transport construction sites and provider literals must use backend.vendor instead of hardcoded vendor values.
